summary: Banco de Chile filed a Form 6-K reporting a routine offshore bond placement under its Medium Term Notes Program. The issuance was MXN 700,000,000 (Mexican Pesos) due May 11, 2033, at a floating rate of TIIE (28 days) + 0.95%. The filing is a standard debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, or other corporate event is involved. The filing is a material information letter to Chilean regulators, equivalent to a US notice of debt issuance. No shareholder vote, board recommendation, or structural changes are present.
